# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, uh, I need a little help with an order.

I’m Noah Patel. I placed an order with a few home office things and some hiking stuff because I thought I was about to become one of those “laptop in the mountains” people. Then, naturally, my company pulled the classic plot twist and said we’re going back to the office soon. Very funny, universe.

So here’s what I’m trying to do:
- If partial cancellation is possible, I want to cancel/return just the home office items and keep the hiking items.
- I honestly don’t remember exactly which office items I ordered, so I’ll need help identifying those from the order.
- I want to know the total amount I’d get back.
- And I’d like the refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then forget it, I’ll just keep the order and roll with my bad decisions. But in that case, I do want to update my default profile address to the Seattle parent house that’s already shown on the order. I’d rather not type the full address out here if possible.

A couple things I know in case you need them:
- Name: Noah Patel
- I’m based in New York, ZIP 10108

One thing I *don’t* know, because my brain has apparently unionized under stress: I don’t remember the email address on the account.

Can you help me figure this out

Yes — I can help with that.

I’ve authenticated your account and found your profile. You have these orders on file:
- #W1845024
- #W7043598
- #W6111398

To figure out whether partial cancellation or return is possible, I need to check the order details first, since it depends on the order status and the specific items in it.

Which order would you like me to look at? If you’re not sure, I can help review them one at a time.

Let’s do them one at a time, because apparently Past Noah liked to leave little mystery boxes for Future Noah.

Can we start with the one that includes the Seattle address and the mix of home office stuff plus hiking items? If you can see which of those three orders matches that, that’s probably the one I need.
